caption: The drawing features a central figure of a woman in a brown dress with a beige mantle and white head covering, standing with her arms crossed over her chest. Behind her is a fan-like halo with gold and gray alternations. She stands within a large, arched niche with green, red, and gold decorative bands, with a garland of flowers draped along the arch. The background of the niche is blue. Above the arched niche is a winged angelic face at the top center. On the left above the arch, there are two cherubs: one holding white lilies, both seated on a gold-and-black-capped ledge with a blue background. On the far right above the arch is a gold urn-like object with a flame at the top, also placed on the ledge. The structure enclosing all elements has vertical red columns with blue panels and gold accents. The composition is symmetrical around the central figure and arch. The artist's name, "EDWARD T. JEWETT," is written in the lower right corner.
title: Fragment of Reredos
